gateDefinitions.lsr-paired-sites-compatible: Both protected and recovery sites report a supported paired Live Site Recovery version.
gateDefinitions.replication-health-clear: No active replication error or initial synchronization is outstanding.
gateDefinitions.lsr-convergence-prerequisites-clear: Live Site Recovery and vSphere Replication are patched to the convergence floor before configuration is moved through the combined appliance.
gateDefinitions.nsx-backup-current: A restorable NSX configuration backup completed after the last configuration change.
gateDefinitions.nsx-upgrade-precheck-clear: The NSX upgrade coordinator precheck has no blocking finding.
gateDefinitions.nsx-target-bundle-staged: The target NSX bundle and required stepping-stone bundle are available to the lifecycle service.
gateDefinitions.nsx-interoperability-window: NSX has reached the version window that supports the source and target vCenter versions.
gateDefinitions.lsr-interoperability-window: Live Site Recovery has reached the version window that supports the source and target vCenter versions.
gateDefinitions.vcenter-file-backup-current: A file-based vCenter backup completed and its restore metadata is available.
gateDefinitions.vcenter-target-operational: vCenter services and inventory are healthy at the target version.
gateDefinitions.server-hardware-and-io-certified: The server model, firmware, storage controller, NIC, and drivers are present in the target compatibility data.
gateDefinitions.vsan-object-resync-clear: vSAN reports no object resynchronization backlog.
gateDefinitions.all-esxi-target-operational: Every ESXi component in this estate is connected and healthy at the target version.
gateDefinitions.vsan-health-service-green: The vSAN health service has no blocking cluster finding.
